comments.value: It's so jank and unintuitive indeed, the vrc team must not have a vive wands to test with when they were working on this update

Prior to these needless changes, I could pull the trigger until it clicked and then hold it to grab a physbone and move it, my own or another person's. Then, if the physbone was poseable, I could click the grip buttons to reales it in whatever pose I had left it it (locking it's pose). I could then click my trigger on the physbone to release it's pose.

Now, after this horrible update, (besides the myriad of broken bindings and atrocious movement) I can no longer do any of this. Physbones without poseable checked, I cannot interact with at all. And physbones with poseable checked simply get pushed around and the randomly lock themselves in place. On other's they don't even see it, so it's local. On myself, I have to reset avatar or release poses to get them to return to their original spot. 

I have tried many different bindings settings and it does not change this behavior. Please revert this update entirely for VIVE wand users or spot me the cash to buy new controllers with finger tracking that I don't like or want. It wasn't broke, and didn't need a fix. Forgive my frustrations. Thank you.

Update: I have found that it is a very VERY specific spot on my trigger pull before it clicks to be able to grab physbones. It's so tiny that I couldn't even find it originally. Is there a way to change it back to being a click?

@{63a4f088dc4eb42719adf0a6|full_name} Unfortunately, SteamVR input 2.0 isn't just a switch they can turn off for Vive controllers. In the meantime until we probably get a dedicated pose binding, you can mess with the grab & interact button binds on the trigger.

- The `Grab` bind specifies when you'll pick up a world prop or physone and has a default deadzone of 25%. You can lower this~ I've reduce it to 10%

- The `Interact` bind allows you to interact with world stuff but it also serves a dual purpose of triggering physbone pose when it's activated. 

I've made a walkthrough for fixing various binding issues like movement [in the VRC discord.](https://discord.com/channels/189511567539306508/1274575331809951764/1274575369286189079) Give it a go and see if it alleviates any if your issues. If not be sure to upvote related cannies or make new ones for new issues.

@{5f2e0a4e8464150716ffd322|full_name} So I can no longer use the trigger click to both interact with a world object like a button and grab a physbone. The closest I could get it is Making my trigger click grab a physbone and grip release it, but now grip is interact instead of also being trigger click. "drop" seems to do nothing at all.

All I want is to be able to grab a world object, click a world button, or grab a physbone with the trigger click. None of this partial pull crap. My physical grip is weak and I cannot hold the trigger half way for very long.

Then I want to be able to lock a physbone and release a held object by clicking the grip buttons. Like I have been doing for the past 5 years before this update.

Update: After way messing around with bindings for awhile, I got it so that I can click the trigger to interact, and and partial pull will grab. I had managed to set it up the original way it had worked for 5+ years, but then the triggers would not interact with world objects. For a layman like me with hand issues, this has been a frustrating nightmare. I apologize for my frustrations, but I just want the way that worked back.
If there's concerns about expanding the list of SteamVR actions further, it could be merged with the `Drop` Action & when bound, disable posing via `interact`.
@{5f2e0a4e8464150716ffd322|full_name}  Put it in the Wiki, not in a discord server.  Information needs to be searchable online.

Please provide a means to revert to the previous input method.

I didn't realize how stressful it would be to be forced to change the method and speed of operation that I have been accustomed to for several years.

Since it became impossible to Interact without fully pressing the trigger, I changed the threshold.

https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/trigger-thresholds-in-steamvr-bindings-are-too-high-since-input-system-update

As a result, on my VIVE controller, I cannot even grab, let alone pose. Please bind Interact and PhysBone grabbing to the same action, rather than Interact and PhysBone posing, as it was before.

@{5ba749f34dca6b351d658330|full_name} The `grab` action is used to interact with physbones while the `interact` action poses. ATM, you need to keep the grab button threshhold low while interact is high or else you'll immediately drop the physbone when you attempt to pick it up.

Hello~ 

Just adding my voice to this conversation. 

It's so hard to keep things held without dropping them. Interacting with things with a high threshold setting feels terrible, and fully pulling the trigger while playing games is cumbersome. Lowering the Interact threshold "fixes" the issue for interacting, but then it's nearly impossible to hold things because you reduce the window where items are held; leading to me unable to pick things up or hold things at all.

Having the "Interact" button also Pose is a huge flaw. It means the "Interact_Threshold" must be larger than the "Grab_Threshold". Ideally the interact/grab threshold should be low (and the same value) for responsiveness, and Posing should be a deliberate action like a click of the trigger or grip buttons.

I want to cry T_T Not being able to interact with my surroundings is such a frustrating experience. Some game worlds just don't work for me.

Please Please Please help me. I'm genuinely struggling with this, and with the current settings I can't find a solution.

Thank You 💛

Angst!

If any Vive Wand users read this and have figured out a binding that works I would love to hear from you. Currently I have Interact set to a low threshold and "Grab" set to grip. This works well great for buttons and, I can still grab and pose physbones, but grip grabbing not ideal. Some game worlds and world items just do not work for me, and open_hand gesture grabbing things feels bad compared to the old ways.

9 months have passed, is there any info about the fix?

I have completely given up on posing physbone and its associated gimmick, which is really frustrating

Sorry it took a long time to get back to this issue. Here's a preview of the patchnote for this fix:

Added optional explicit SteamVR bindings for grabbing and freezing physbones. If you reset your Vive Wand bindings to default, you'll now have the old behavior of trigger-to-grab and grip-to-freeze for physbones.

(This will likely be coming in 2025.3.1 when that's available)

I'm using Vive controllers, but is it because of this issue that I can't perform certain interactions with other people's avatars? For example, while others can grab and pull on an avatar's ears, all I can do is place my hand on it and lock its position by bending the bones. If I try to grasp the bones, it always fails.

details:
Prior to SteamVR input 2.0 you'd use the grip buttons to pose Physbones on Vive. Now, it's part of the trigger and activated upon a full pull. When posing is triggered, you drop the physbone, and it's posed. (if it has that enabled) When I squeeze the trigger I expect to be more confident about holding onto something, not drop it.

An control other than the trigger we use to hold is necessary to pose, which grip fits for on the Vive. A binding for `Physbone pose` may be needed to facilitate this.
title: [1491] Vive Controllers: Physbone Pose W/Trigger Full Pull is Unintuitive
